name: Arkansas

agency.name: Arkansas Department of Energy and Environment, Division of Environmental Quality (DEQ)
agency.division: Office of Air Quality, Permits Branch

overview: Arkansas DEQ issues registrations, minor source permits, general permits, and Title V permits under APC&EC Rules 18, 19, and 26. Permits must be obtained before construction begins. Minor source permits do not expire; general and Title V permits have five-year terms.

permitTypes.name: Rule 18.315 Registration
permitTypes.description: For facilities with actual emissions in the registration band. Fixed fee per DEQ FAQ.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DEQ FAQ 8 (total facility actual emissions, tpy): CO 40 to <75; NOx 25 to <40; SO2 25 to <40; VOC 25 to <40; PM 15 to <25; PM10 10 to <15; single HAP 1 to <2; combined HAPs 3 to <5.

permitTypes.name: Minor Source Permit
permitTypes.description: Required above registration levels and below Title V, and for certain listed source categories regardless of emission rate. Does not expire.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DEQ FAQ 8 (tpy): CO 75 to <100; NOx, SO2, VOC 40 to <100; PM 25 or more; PM10 15 to <100; direct PM2.5 10 to <100; lead 0.5 to <10; single HAP 2 to <10; combined HAPs 5 to <25; any other air contaminant 25 or more.

permitTypes.name: General Permits
permitTypes.description: Coverage by Notice of Intent via SEEK. Minor source GPs: animal/human remains incinerators, cotton gins, gasoline bulk plants, hot mix asphalt, natural gas compression stations, rock crushing. Title V GPs: air curtain incinerators, cotton gins. Five-year term.

permitTypes.name: PSD
permitTypes.description: Major source permitting in attainment areas under Arkansas's SIP (Rule 19). DEQ notes greenhouse gas permitting applies only to sources otherwise required to obtain a PSD permit.

permitTypes.name: Title V Permit
permitTypes.description: Required at major source levels or when a federal regulation requires one. Five-year term.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DEQ FAQ 8 (total facility emissions, tpy): CO, NOx, SO2, VOC, PM10, PM2.5 100 or more; lead 10 or more; single HAP 10 or more; combined HAPs 25 or more.

oilAndGas.summary: Arkansas has a minor source General Air Permit for Natural Gas Compression Stations, obtained by Notice of Intent.

programs.name: General Air Permit for Minor Source Natural Gas Compression Stations
programs.description: General permit (1868-AGP-000) for minor source compressor stations.
